newsitem.title: INDIA: India I-Sec's debt market portfolio watch list.
newsitem.headline: India I-Sec's debt market portfolio watch list.

text.p: ICICI Securities and Finance Company (I-Sec) said it placed the following securities in its "portfolio watch" representing stocks that are likely to outperform the market.
Security Residual Modified Net Price Yield Weightage

The portfolio is heavily weighted in favour of the 364 day treasury bill to be auctioned on 16 July and the new six year government bond. It has been assumed that the treasury bill and the six year bond are acquired in the auction at an yield of 8.49 percent and a price of 100.15 rupees respectively. The weightage for the other medium and long term securities has been scaled down significantly on expectation of a price correction in these towards the end of the next fortnight.
